text:
Maya: Quick sync  we need a compact plan for the next design-partner cohort. goals: predictable capacity, clear feedback cadence, and launch gates for a closed beta. can we agree on commitments today?
Luca: 👍 Agree. Propose cohort cap = 8 partners, staggered in two waves of 4 so infra can absorb onboarding spikes.
Priya: For routing, signals = QPS estimate bucket, PII/regulatory flag, and integration complexity. but add a "willingness to share prompts/evals" boolean — that matters for our eval loop.
Dev: Onboarding SLAs: concierge contact within 48h for Concierge track; Fasttrack gets a 72h tech handoff. We should publish these in the invite email.
Kim: Metrics to gate closed beta: 1) 3 verticals represented, 2) cohort NPS >= +30 at week 4, 3) no >P1 regressions, 4) onboarding drop-off <20%. If any fail, pause new invites.
Maya: Nice. Feedback cadence: weekly short sync + one detailed survey at week 2 and week 6. require partners to commit to at least 4 feedback artifacts (e.g., logs, prompts, 1-hour interview).
Luca: Compensation: offer $1k credit + early-pricing guarantee. For healthcare/finserv require explicit legal telemetry waiver.
Priya: Instrumentation handshake: partners must enable structured telemetry (request_id, route, model_version) and provide 1 anonymized prompt set. add a minimal spec in the invite.
Dev: Rollback triggers we can automate: if error-rate >3% sustained for 1 hour OR time-to-first-successful-call median > 48h for >=3 partners, auto-fail new onboarding and alert SRE.
OpsBot: FYI: staging quota now has 6 reserved GPU slots for Fasttrack. If cohort grows to 8 Fasttrack partners, we need to reserve 4 more.
Kim: Scope negotiation: require partners to accept a 6-week feedback window. if they need deeper integrations beyond 40 dev-hours, treat as paid concierge and schedule separately.
Maya: Action items: Luca to finalize cohort cap + wave schedule (ETA EOD). Priya to add the "eval willingness" field to intake form and sample-weighting in analytics (ETA Tue). Dev to add automated rollback rules to onboarding pipeline (ETA tomorrow). Kim to draft invite + telemetry spec and legal checklist (ETA today).
Priya: Also request that analytics flag single-partner dominance in metrics and downweight appropriately.
Maya: Great. We'll run an intake smoke test against the simulate endpoint once Dev finishes. Reopen when invites are ready. Thanks all :tada:
